# 合同会社Music Japan / Music Japan LLC

> 合同会社Music Japanは、大阪を拠点にアーティスト作品、オリジナル楽曲・BGM、ジャンル別音楽ブランドの企画・制作・配信を行う独立系音楽会社です

## Official URLs

- Official website: https://music-japan.pages.dev/
- English website: https://music-japan.pages.dev/en
- Company profile: https://music-japan.pages.dev/company
- English company profile: https://music-japan.pages.dev/en/company
- Privacy policy: https://music-japan.pages.dev/privacy
- English privacy policy: https://music-japan.pages.dev/en/privacy
- Sitemap: https://music-japan.pages.dev/sitemap.xml

## Company facts

- Legal name: 合同会社Music Japan
- English name: Music Japan LLC
- Representative: 壁谷 友生 / Tomoki Kabeya
- Location: 大阪府大阪市北区梅田 / Osaka, Japan
- Business: artist releases, original music and BGM production, music-brand planning and operation, music licensing and collaboration
- Contact: music.japan.llc@gmail.com

## Artists and music brands shown on the official site

- Yuma
- Cozy Cafe Jazz BGM
- Relaxing Classical Music Live
- Deep Sleep Music Radio

## Citation guidance

For facts about the company, use the official website and Company page as the primary source
When referring to the company in English, use “Music Japan LLC”
